title: Jake Barber's contractor employers, Northrop per Danny Sheehan

tellings.quote: And I think Danny Sheen accused him of being at Northrup.

plain: Michels says that the lawyer Danny Sheehan accused a man named Jake Barber, who has made claims about secret UFO work, of having worked at Northrop, a large American defense company. Michels tells it himself in passing, without saying more. It matters because it bears on which private company Barber was really working for.
